name: platform-policy
instructions:
Platform-owned publisher policy for the demo catalog. It declares ONE consequential authority -- deployments:rollback -- because an agent cannot be GRANTED authority its governed catalog entry does not declare, and the agent-requested-action gate exists to prove exactly that grant being exercised.

The ceiling is platform-wide in this schema: every agent in a snapshot published against it shares it. That is stated here rather than discovered, and it is why this file is separate from the empty-ceiling policy the other demos use -- publishing the demo catalog against THIS one is a deliberate act, not a default.

The ceiling is what an agent may be granted, never what it holds. A run still receives only the intersection of the user's entitlements, the scope the trigger asked for, and this -- so an agent under this policy that is triggered without deployments:rollback holds none.
